[EN] People get down on Nema a lot, but they just don't realize the genius in her.

Just listen to her go on about history for a while—it's intoxicating!
[ES] La gente critica mucho a Nema, pero simplemente no se dan cuenta de su genio.

Solo escúchala hablar de historia por un rato... ¡es embriagador!
